options.content: Reference only: these connector/layerwise metrics are emitted by the vLLM integration, not the current SGLang connector. Their absence under SGLang is expected.

panels.description:
- `Load`：`rate(ucm:load_bytes_total) / 1e9`；Connector 聚合加载带宽，包含任务间的空闲时间。代码位置：`ucm/integration/vllm/ucm_connector.py` / `UCMDirectConnector.start_load_kv`、`UCMLayerWiseConnector.wait_for_layer_load`，`ucm/integration/vllm/hla_connector.py` / `UCMHybridLinearAttentionLayerWiseConnector._record_layerwise_load_bytes`，`ucm/integration/vllm/hma_connector.py` / `UCMFAWAConnector._wait_all_load_task` / Load 完成后。
- `Save`：`rate(ucm:save_bytes_total) / 1e9`；Connector 聚合保存带宽，包含任务间的空闲时间。代码位置：`ucm/integration/vllm/ucm_connector.py`、`ucm/integration/vllm/hla_connector.py`、`ucm/integration/vllm/hma_connector.py` / 各 Connector 的 `wait_for_save` / Dump 成功提交后。
panels.title: Connector Aggregate Bandwidth

panels.description: 指标：`ucm:connector_wait_for_save_duration_ms`；Connector 接口 `wait_for_save` 的墙钟耗时，本面板展示 avg、p50、p90 和 p99。代码位置：`ucm/integration/vllm/ucm_connector.py` / `_record_connector_interface_duration` / 接口返回时。

panels.title: vLLM connector only / additional histogram metrics
save_duration / distribution
panels.description:
Time from UCM connector wait_for_save entry to async dump task completion (ms)

Missing series means not emitted, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, model_name, worker_id) (rate(${ucm_prefix}save_duration_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, instance, model_name, worker_id) (rate(${ucm_prefix}save_duration_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job, instance, model_name, worker_id) (rate(${ucm_prefix}save_duration_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance, model_name, worker_id) (rate(${ucm_prefix}save_duration_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job, instance, model_name, worker_id) (rate(${ucm_prefix}save_duration_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval])))
